operating_performance.text: Passengers were broadly unchanged at {{passengers@FY2025}}, a change of {{passengers.change@FY2025}}, with the fleet stable at {{fleet@FY2025}} aircraft and an average age of {{fleet_age@FY2025}}.
The fuel share of costs fell by {{fuel_share_of_costs.change@FY2025}} to {{fuel_share_of_costs@FY2025}}, above the peer median of {{fuel_share_of_costs.peer_median@FY2025}}.
Costs related to environmental regulation increased significantly during the year, with greater use of sustainable aviation fuel and changes to the EU Emissions Trading System weighing on the result.
During the year Finnair purchased leased A321 aircraft, and all aircraft were in operative use at the balance sheet date.

peer_positioning.text: Finnair's strongest position is cash liquidity to revenue of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2025}}, the highest of the network peers ({{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_rank@FY2025}}) against a median of {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.peer_median@FY2025}}.

It is weakest on profitability and leverage: the EBITDA margin of {{ebitda_margin@FY2025}} and net leverage of {{net_leverage@FY2025}} both rank last of the group ({{ebitda_margin.peer_rank@FY2025}} and {{net_leverage.peer_rank@FY2025}}).
FCF to debt sits in the middle of the group, and capex intensity is below the peer median of {{capex_intensity.peer_median@FY2025}}.

watch_items.text: Profitability: the EBITDA margin of {{ebitda_margin@FY2025}} is below the peer median of {{ebitda_margin.peer_median@FY2025}}, and the industrial action in the first half weighed on the result.

Cash generation: FFO to debt fell by {{ffo_to_debt.change@FY2025}} to {{ffo_to_debt@FY2025}}, below the peer median of {{ffo_to_debt.peer_median@FY2025}}, and FCF to debt fell by {{fcf_to_debt.change@FY2025}} to {{fcf_to_debt@FY2025}}.
Leverage: gross leverage of {{gross_leverage@FY2025}} is above the peer median of {{gross_leverage.peer_median@FY2025}}, the weakest of the group ({{gross_leverage.peer_rank@FY2025}}).

Costs: the fuel share of costs of {{fuel_share_of_costs@FY2025}} is above the peer median of {{fuel_share_of_costs.peer_median@FY2025}}, and costs related to environmental regulation increased significantly during the year.
